action_instruction: Checking the Salary deposit in the Checking transaction list
intent: whether the Salary transaction row in the Checking transaction list has a deposit amount of 300.00

action_params.condition: the Checking transaction list has a row with payee "Salary" and a deposit of 300.00
action_params.query: whether the Salary transaction row in the Checking transaction list has a deposit amount of 300.00

action_instruction: Checking whether the Grocer payment row is listed
intent: whether the Grocer transaction row with a payment of 45.20 is present in the Checking transaction list

action_params.condition: the "Grocer" row with a payment of 45.20 is still listed
action_params.query: whether the Grocer transaction row with a payment of 45.20 is present in the Checking transaction list

assertion_tree.description: the Checking transaction list has a row with payee "Salary" and a deposit of 300.00, and the "Grocer" row with a payment of 45.20 is still listed

sub_results.description: the Checking transaction list has a row with payee "Salary" and a deposit of 300.00
the "Grocer" row with a payment of 45.20 is still listed

assertion_tree.verification: The current Checking transaction list contains the specified Salary deposit row and Grocer payment row.
